ios.desc:
WakeAI is a behavioural operating system that learns how you actually live and manages your day automatically.

Most apps wait for you to tell them what to do. WakeAI doesn't.

WHAT WAKEAI DOES
• Learns your sleep patterns via Apple Health and suggests personalised wake times
• Set alarms, reminders and calendar events through natural conversation
• Monitors traffic and tells you exactly when to leave for appointments
• Upload a photo or PDF of a schedule and it extracts all appointments automatically
• Remembers everything you tell it permanently across sessions
• Shows your sleep, steps, heart rate and location in one daily dashboard
• Gets smarter the more you use it — the behavioural engine builds your profile over time

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
WakeAI is free to try. Premium plans unlock the full behavioural OS:

Essential — Unlimited AI, smart alarms, persistent memory, behavioural insights
Pro — Everything in Essential plus calendar intelligence, leave-time alerts and document scanning

All paid plans include a 3-day free trial. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.
